rawSchemaSql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "public"."trips" (
    "id" uuid,
    "owner_user_id" uuid,
    "name" text,
    "description" text,
    "metadata" jsonb,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "updated_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "vehicle_preset" text,
    "vehicle_profile" text,
    "vehicle_type" text,
    "vehicle_restrictions" jsonb
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "public"."trip_members" (
    "trip_id" uuid,
    "user_id" uuid,
    "role" text,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "updated_at" timestamp with time zone
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "public"."destinations" (
    "id" uuid,
    "trip_id" uuid,
    "name" text,
    "country_region" text,
    "lat" double precision,
    "lng" double precision,
    "location" jsonb,
    "stop_order" integer,
    "status" text,
    "priority" text,
    "timing" jsonb,
    "why" jsonb,
    "media" jsonb,
    "research" jsonb,
    "activities" jsonb,
    "route_context" jsonb,
    "tags" text[],
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "updated_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "routing_anchors" jsonb
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "public"."route_legs" (
    "id" uuid,
    "trip_id" uuid,
    "origin_destination_id" uuid,
    "target_destination_id" uuid,
    "status" text,
    "distance_km" double precision,
    "travel_time_hours" double precision,
    "geometry" jsonb,
    "provider" text,
    "profile" text,
    "route_key" text,
    "calculated_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "error" text,
    "notes" text,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "updated_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "movement" text,
    "calculation_mode" text,
    "ferry_policy" text,
    "waypoints" jsonb,
    "sections" jsonb,
    "warnings" jsonb,
    "provider_diagnostic" jsonb
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "public"."activities" (
    "id" uuid,
    "trip_id" uuid,
    "destination_id" uuid,
    "activity_order" integer,
    "title" text,
    "description" text,
    "category" text,
    "status" text,
    "priority" text,
    "location" jsonb,
    "links" jsonb,
    "notes" text,
    "tags" text[],
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "updated_at" timestamp with time zone
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "public"."media_assets" (
    "id" uuid,
    "trip_id" uuid,
    "destination_id" uuid,
    "bucket_id" text,
    "object_path" text,
    "caption" text,
    "credit" text,
    "content_type" text,
    "size_bytes" bigint,
    "uploaded_by" uuid,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "updated_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "sort_order" integer,
    "activity_id" uuid
);
